# Foundations of Singular Learning Theory

This section collects introductory and core material on the foundations of Singular Learning Theory (SLT).  
These pages serve as lightweight notes, definitions, and references for concepts that appear throughout the SLT posts.

## Topics included here

- Real Log Canonical Thresholds (RLCT)
- Zeta functions and singularities
- Resolution of singularities
- Asymptotic forms of the free energy and marginal likelihood
- Basic examples from Watanabe (e.g., normal mixture, reduced rank regression)

Use the sidebar on the left to explore individual topics as they are added.
